resumen.en: Help Dr. Vektor remove a virus from the Digital World and unlock permanent access to the Porygon area.

instrucciones.en: Complete the computer sequence and defeat Giant Porygon within 45 minutes, then return to Dr. Vektor.

requisitos.en: Accept to help with the research

pasos.en: Use the computer beside Dr. Vektor

recompensas.en: Permanent access to the Porygon-area computer

notas.en: The instance accepts one player at a time.
The computer positions change on a new attempt.
